offers.sn: Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth Observation constellation and software to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery.
offers.rq: Master’s in computer science, machine learning, physics, mathematics, or related field. 10+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or computer vision. 2+ years in a leadership role managing ML teams. Proficiency in English (written and spoken). Nice to have: PhD in computer science, machine learning, physics, mathematics, or related field.
